description: Turns repeated blocks on a page (a menu) into a list: the first call previews items and markup and returns confirm_token; the same call with it, after the user agrees, creates the list, adds the items and publishes the page. Lists are optional: only when the user asks for one.

confirm_token.description: From the first call: re-call with it for the approval status

fields.description: {field: selector in a block; "": the block}

import.description: Add items to a list that has some

name: bind_list
title: Make page content a list
